result.reason: The redline appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors and removes Vendor’s unilateral revocation right, but it does not reach the playbook position because the licence remains non-transferable, with no exception for successors in an M&A transaction. It also does not expressly make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable; incorporation of Section 13.3 may address subscription termination only if that section limits termination to uncured material breach. The changes made are targeted and professionally phrased, but the operative language is incomplete.
